context: The French revolution of 1789—for Marx the most spectacular example of the bourgeois revolutions—was fought under the banner, “Liberty, Equality and Fraternity”
meaning: 以“自由、平等、博爱”为号召进行革命；中性偏褒
current_zh: 它是在“自由、平等、博爱”的旗帜下进行的
suggest: 高举“自由、平等、博爱”的旗帜
note: 旗帜比喻中文现成，现译可用；不要改成“打着……的旗号”，那会暗示口号是幌子，原文无此意

context: The same themes echo through the nineteenth-century revolutions of national independence.
meaning: 同样的主题在十九世纪的民族独立革命中一再出现
current_zh: 十九世纪争取民族独立的革命，也一再回响着同样的主题。
suggest: 同样的主题也贯穿了十九世纪的历次民族独立革命
note: “回响”略带翻译腔，换成平实的“贯穿”更顺；没有更贴切的成语，不硬套

context: which drove the Russian leadership to undertake the first Five Year Plan, to lurch into the collectivization of agriculture
meaning: 仓促、跌跌撞撞地一头转入农业集体化；略带贬义，指缺乏准备
current_zh: 仓促推进农业集体化
suggest: 一头扎进农业集体化
note: lurch 有踉跄失衡、猛然转向之意；“一头扎进”保留冒失感，力度相当；不要加“盲目”之类原文没有的定性

context: and to pursue blitzkrieg industrialization in the ensuing years, with all the toll of social deprivation involved
meaning: 以闪电战式的高速推进工业化
current_zh: 随后又以闪电战般的速度推进工业化
suggest: 闪电式工业化
note: 保留军事比喻即可；“突击”是当年中苏都常用的说法，也贴切，但少了“闪电战”的外国战争色彩

en: with all the toll of social deprivation involved
context: and to pursue blitzkrieg industrialization in the ensuing years, with all the toll of social deprivation involved.
meaning: 伴随而来的种种民生困苦的代价
current_zh: 社会为此付出了生活严重匮乏的代价。
suggest: 社会为此吃尽了苦头
alt: 付出了民生困苦的沉重代价
note: toll 指损耗、代价；“吃尽苦头”口语而力度相当；若嫌太口语用备选

context: The compulsion is extreme for States that have started in the race late, are “economically backward’, and particularly so, the more dedicated they are to national independence.
meaning: 在列强竞赛中起跑较晚的国家
current_zh: 对于那些起步较晚、经济落后的国家来说
suggest: 起步较晚
note: 赛跑比喻承接上句 rivalries；现译“起步较晚”已贴切，保留

en: already has within its grasp the conquest of scarcity
context: Marx contrasts this situation with that in advanced capitalism where accumulation is well established and skills are more abundant: society already has within its grasp the conquest of scarcity.
meaning: 社会已经有能力战胜匮乏，近在手边
current_zh: 社会已经具备消除匮乏的条件
suggest: 社会战胜匮乏已经触手可及
note: 属马克思理论转述，比喻点到为止；不用“唾手可得”，那会显得过于轻易

context: the capitalists, once the precondition for social progress, have become now a “fetter on production”, a parasitic formation no longer required to maintain production.
meaning: 马克思用语：阻碍生产力发展的束缚
current_zh: 现在却已经变成“生产的桎梏”
suggest: 生产的桎梏
note: 马克思著作通行中译术语，属理论用语，保持不动

context: have become now a “fetter on production”, a parasitic formation no longer required to maintain production.
meaning: 依附生产而不再为生产所必需的社会集团；贬义
current_zh: 变成一种维持生产已不再必要的寄生性结构
suggest: 一个生产已不再需要的寄生集团
note: 理论语境，不宜改成“寄生虫”之类骂人口语；“结构”不如“集团/阶层”准确，formation 指社会构成

context: A government which tried to prevent an increase in inequality at the same time as it pushed forward accumulation would be caught in a contradiction: either accumulation would be sacrificed to preventing inequality, or vice versa.
meaning: 两种目标相互冲突，只能顾一头
current_zh: 便会陷入矛盾：要么为了防止不平等而牺牲积累，要么为了积累而牺牲平等。
suggest: 顾此失彼
note: 冒号后正是“要么……要么……”，“顾此失彼”分毫不差；放在概括处，后面的推理照直译，不影响说理

context: but then the bureaucracy becomes a separate social formation, consuming an increasing share of the surplus and so defeating the whole purpose.
meaning: 结果与初衷相反，使整个目的落空
current_zh: 从而反过来破坏整个目标
suggest: 适得其反
note: 成语与原意完全对应，中性；不用“南辕北辙”（指方向一开始就错）

en: The retreat of the New Economic Policy
context: The retreat of the New Economic Policy—a partial revival of private capitalism and trade—produced more marked inequality
meaning: 列宁本人把新经济政策称为“退却”
current_zh: 新经济政策的退却
suggest: 新经济政策这一退却
note: 历史用语，保留“退却”，与第12章“‘退却’被说成前进”呼应；不换成语

context: Molotov went further and demanded that egalitarians be rooted out as class enemies
meaning: 当作阶级敌人彻底铲除；力度强
current_zh: 要求把平均主义者当成阶级敌人清除出去
suggest: 当作阶级敌人铲除
note: root out 是连根拔，“清除出去”稍弱；“铲除”力度对等

context: The approach to pay straddled a contradiction.
meaning: 工资政策两脚分跨在一对相互冲突的要求上
current_zh: 中国的工资政策陷入了一个矛盾。
suggest: 工资政策夹在一对矛盾中间
note: straddle 是跨在两边，“夹在中间”比“陷入”贴切；不要用“脚踩两只船”，那是投机的贬义

context: Thus, different levels of consumption are not the result of the existence of classes, they are the cause of the existence of classes. This turns Marx on his head.
meaning: 把马克思的唯物主义因果关系颠倒过来；暗用马克思说黑格尔辩证法“倒立着”的典故
current_zh: 这就把马克思的理论颠倒了。
suggest: 这就把马克思头足倒置了
note: 保留身体倒立的画面，懂行的读者能看出典故；“本末倒置”意思对但丢了典故，作备选

context: Curbing the tendency of the cadre to indulge his appetite does not take the form of control of his income
meaning: 干部放纵物质享受的欲望
current_zh: 遏制干部放纵欲望的方式
suggest: 贪图享受
note: 呼应前面引文中的“图享受”；“口腹之欲”偏窄，appetite 在此泛指享受

en: dissolves the yoke of the social division of labour
context: It is material abundance—and what flows from this, high incomes for all – which dissolves the yoke of the social division of labour and “bourgeois right”
meaning: 解除社会分工和资产阶级法权套在人身上的轭
current_zh: 消解社会分工和“资产阶级法权”桎梏的
suggest: 打破社会分工和“资产阶级法权”的枷锁
note: yoke 原指牛轭；用“枷锁”可与前文 fetter=桎梏 区分开；理论段落，比喻不宜再加码

context: Is China on the threshold of such a situation?
meaning: 是否已接近、即将进入那个阶段
current_zh: 中国是否已站在这一阶段的门槛上？
suggest: 中国是否已经走到了这一步的门口？
note: 门槛比喻中文也通，现译可留；不宜用“指日可待”，那带肯定预期

en: In the excitable climate of the Cultural Revolution
context: In the excitable climate of the Cultural Revolution, such enormous pay differentials must have provoked much resentment.
meaning: 文革期间人心容易激动的气氛
current_zh: 在文革激昂的气氛中
suggest: 在文革群情激昂的气氛里
note: “群情激昂”无褒贬；“人心浮动”略带贬，作备选

en: on the verge of, or below, subsistence level
context: The range is between incomes well above those received by the mass of the city population and pay on the verge of, or below, subsistence level.
meaning: 收入仅够或不够维持最低生存
current_zh: 收入跨度从显著高于大多数城市居民，到徘徊在生存边缘甚至低于生存线之间。
suggest: 仅够糊口、甚至难以糊口
note: subsistence 指维持生存，比“温饱”还低一档，不用“温饱线”；现译句式“从……到……之间”也宜顺一顺

context: The differential work point system is justified on the grounds that women are physically less strong than men, a stock rationalization in most societies
meaning: 各社会为既成的不平等找的陈套借口；轻微贬义
current_zh: 这是多数社会都会使用的现成说法
suggest: 这是大多数社会的老一套说辞
note: rationalization 是找理由开脱，“说辞/托词”带轻微贬义，与原文一致；“老生常谈”只指话陈旧，不含开脱义，不用

context: In the countryside, some families can afford new and better housing, can spend open-handedly on festivals, weddings and durables
meaning: 花钱大方
current_zh: 也能在节庆、婚礼与耐用品上大手笔花钱
suggest: 出手阔绰
note: 中性，无讽刺

context: the rich areas no doubt would be happy to be left alone to be “self-reliant” while devil take the poor.
meaning: 化用 devil take the hindmost：各顾各，落在后面的没人管
current_zh: 至于穷地方，就任它自生自灭。
suggest: 穷地方的死活就没人管了
note: 现译“自生自灭”已贴切；“各人自扫门前雪”侧重富者自顾，口气俏皮，与作者挖苦语气相合，但把焦点从穷地方移到富地方，慎用；整句的讽刺另见讽刺表

context: partly in the lack of typical Western signs of inequality and in the insensitivity of foreign visitors to the language of social status in China
meaning: 中国社会里表示身份地位的种种暗示与讲究
current_zh: 外国来访者又不善于识别中国社会地位的种种信号
suggest: 外国来访者看不懂中国人表示身份地位的那套门道
note: “门道”口语，指外人不懂的规矩，贴切；现译“信号”也可

en: has to go a long way to reach
context: China has to go a long way to reach the degree of equality in the Russia of the New Economic Policy, let alone anything the 1917 Bolshevik leadership would have regarded as “socialism”.
meaning: 离那种平等程度还差得很远
current_zh: 中国离俄国新经济政策时期那种平等程度还相距甚远
suggest: 中国要达到俄国新经济政策时期的平等程度，还差得远
note: 不要用“任重道远”，那是褒义、带决心，与作者冷峻语气不合

en: retained intact throughout all the different emphases of policy
context: That structure, laid down in 1956, appeared to have been retained intact throughout all the different emphases of policy.
meaning: 政策侧重几经变化，结构始终未变
current_zh: 那个结构在 1956 年确立之后，似乎在此后所有政策强调的更替中都原封未动。
suggest: 任凭政策重点几经变换，1956 年定下的这套结构似乎始终原封不动
note: “原封不动”本已在现译中（作“原封未动”），主要是把“政策强调的更替”这一翻译腔改顺；不用“以不变应万变”，那会多出策略判断

en: a few voluntary pay cuts do not affect the situation
context: the differences in official incomes appear so marked ... that a few voluntary pay cuts do not affect the situation.
meaning: 少数人自愿降薪对整体格局毫无影响
current_zh: 少数人的自愿降薪也改变不了局面
suggest: 少数人自愿降薪无济于事
note: “无济于事”中性贴切；“杯水车薪”强调数量太少，也合原意，但多了一层画面

en: The picture is therefore extremely varied
context: The picture is therefore extremely varied—between brigades or teams working in intensive farming ... and villages in the barren hill areas
meaning: 各地农村情况差别极大
current_zh: 农村景象因此差异极大。
suggest: 农村情况因此千差万别
note: 成语与原意完全对应，中性

en: would barely change the national picture of differentials
context: such changes—even if there were firm and comprehensive information—would barely change the national picture of differentials
meaning: 对全国收入差距的总体格局几乎没有影响
current_zh: 这些变化也几乎不会改变全国收入差距的面貌
suggest: 这些变化于全国收入差距的大局无关
alt: 动不了全国差距的大格局
note: 可用“无关大局”；不用“无关痛痒”，那带漠不关心的意味
